text: Plug in tools from anywhere over the Model Context Protocol — they show up to Claude automatically.
Skills are short, opinionated playbooks Claude calls up when the moment is right.
See exactly where your tokens go — spend broken down per session, per model, per day.
Run the agent on a cron schedule — daily standups, deploy checks, log triage, without you there.
Claude keeps notes that persist across sessions, so you don't re-explain the same context.
Watch how full your context window is — and compact it before it overflows.
Set a goal for this session and Claude tracks it until it's achieved.
Browse the exact project tree the agent sees — with quick file previews.
Run shell commands at lifecycle events — guardrails, notifications, auto-formatting.
Install community plugins from any marketplace you trust — skills, agents, MCP servers, and hooks.
Rebind any shortcut — including chords — to match the muscle memory you already have.
Lost? Open the full list of slash commands and keyboard shortcuts.
Cut the chrome and keep just the conversation in view — /focus cycles a distraction-free layout.
Prefer a dedicated window? /desktop opens — or recommends — the Claudius desktop app.
Running multiple Claude sessions? Use /color and /rename to tell them apart at a glance.
Liked Plan Mode? Make it sticky in Workspace settings → Permission mode (it'll apply to every new session here).
New to Claudius? Run /powerup for a quick interactive tutorial.
